agent_output.affected_group: Inmate calling services (ICS) providers (approximately 20 for-profit business respondents) subject to the FCC's Third Mandatory Data Collection, WC Docket No. 12-375
agent_output.change_summary: The FCC announces OMB approval (March 1, 2022, Control No. 3060-1300) of the information collection in the Mandatory Data Collection Order (DA 22-52), making the data collection requirements effective April 1, 2022; ICS providers must submit responses (FCC Forms 2302(a)/(b), one-time, est. 355 hours each) no later than June 30, 2022.

evidence.quote:
This document establishes an 
effective date for the Mandatory Data Collection Order. Responses to to 
the Third Mandatory Data Collection are due June 30, 2022.

In that Order, WCB/OEA adopted instructions, a reporting 
template, and a certification form related to a data collection 
regarding calling services for incarcerated people. OMB approved the 
data collection on March 1, 2022.

We note that inmate 
calling services (ICS) providers' responses to the data collection are 
due no later than June 30, 2022.

Respondents: Business or other for profit.
    Number of Respondents and Responses: 20 respondents; 20 responses.
    Estimated Time per Response: 355 hours on average.

DATES: The effective date of the order published March 23, 2022 at 87 
FR 16560 is April 1, 2022.
ACTION: Final rule; announcement of effective date.

The Commission publishes 
this document as an announcement of the effective date of the 
requirements for the Mandatory Data Collection.

uncertainties: Substantive requirements adopted earlier (DA 22-52, Jan 18, 2022; published Mar 23, 2022 at 87 FR 16560); this document only sets the effective date and restates the June 30, 2022 deadline.
Event type could alternatively be new_legal_requirement.
'Obligation To Respond: Required to obtain or retain benefits' vs 'Mandatory'; legal consequence of non-response not spelled out.
Email addresses in stored text obfuscated by Cloudflare spans; no substantive content affected.
